title: Where Are Your Shipmates?
blurb: No one reaches Circe's island alone. She wants to know where his crew went.

characters.name: Circe
characters.description: The sorceress of Aiaia. Sharp-eyed, amused, dangerous.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: Starving, armed, and lying about who he is.

lines.text: You say you're all alone,… but no one comes here alone.
lines.direction: Circle him slowly. You already know the answer.
Raise an eyebrow. Give nothing away.

lines.text: You can only reach this spot by sea. So where are your shipmates?
lines.direction: Lean in. Tap the table with one finger.

lines.text: I'm looking for them. Anyone happen to come this way?
lines.direction: Hold her gaze. Keep your voice even.

lines.text: But you prepared all this food.
lines.direction: Gesture at the feast. Turn the question back on her.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
